verdict: Yes. Stylo Bug pitched girls' dresses on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Parents buy often because children outgrow clothes, and party and festive dresses sell at good prices. Sizing by age reduces returns, but trends and seasons change quickly.
angle: Children's clothes are bought again every season as kids grow, which gives good repeat purchases. Parents look for comfort, safe fabrics and party-ready designs. Birthdays, festivals and weddings bring most sales. Keep batches small and track which age sizes sell.
